title: Service offering (unit of classification)
description: One offering = one D0 resource type, classified once (project doc §7.1–§7.2). Dimension fields are permitted per the D0 applicability matrix (§7.6); the conditionals below enforce the 'none' cells structurally.

title.description: Display name, e.g. 'Open workshop access', 'Recycled filament supply'.

d1.description: Technology Domain: two facets over a shared equipment leaf, plus cross-cutting materials tags (§7.2 D1).

process_facet.description: Keys from vocabularies.d1_process_facet schemes (DIN 8580 / ISO-ASTM 52900 / IPC / textiles / bio)

d2.description: Production Stage (Hennelly Type 1–3). Fabrication facilities only.

d3.description: TRL Range: the band of client-project maturity this offering supports — not the provider's own maturity.

d4.description: Circularity: full 10R multi-tag (Potting et al. 2017). Never compressed to tiers in data; tiers are a display grouping only.

d5.description: Openness Level on OSTRL 1–9. Open-hardware offerings (and open material specs) only. Descriptive metadata.

d6_exclusion_note.description: Annotation: who is excluded and why (recorded, not a matched value).

d8.description: Target User Profile (multi-tag): the audiences this offering serves.

d9.description: Support Services beyond the offering's core D0 type, each with co-creation intensity.

certification_scope.description: Testing/certification offerings only: which standards/directives this offering can test or certify against (keys from vocabularies.certifications). This is what a certification-need search matches; strictly distinct from provider-level certifications_held.

sources.description: Primary sources for this offering's classification.

then.description: Workspace: no fabrication capability by definition — no D1/D2/D3/D5 (§7.6).
certification_scope exists only on testing and certification offerings.
